findings.claim: The spring release adds session tokens for stateful servers, retires batch requests, requires servers to declare supported versions, and takes effect on 2031-06-01.
Teams migrated within six weeks of the spring release, and the session token rollout finished before 2031-06-01.

Two gateways needed patches because they relied on batch requests. Three gateway teams (1, 2, and 3) each reported patching their batch handling during the spring rollout. The search reported a partial failure (connection refused after 4 attempts), so there may be additional reports not captured.
No customer outage was recorded during the spring release rollout. A separate search for customer outages returned no matching records.
Vendor support contracts rose by about 4 percent after the release.
Most teams migrated in the eight weeks before 2031-06-01. This differs from the rollout notes, which say teams migrated within six weeks.

No findings are available for regional rollout (connection timeout after 4 attempts), security audit (403: requires the compliance role), or legal exemption (data sharing on hold pending contract review).
